ns2:course.label: Off-Road Vehicle Mechatronics
ns2:course.description: Fundamentals of mechatronic systems design; modeling of off-road vehicle systems, on-vehicle information management, and intelligent vehicle controls. Emphasizes integrated skills in designing mechatronic systems for off-road vehicles. Prerequisite: One of ABE 425, ME 461, MFGE 430; ECE 486 or ME 460.
